name: praman-type-compat-fixture
description: Compiles against the packed playwright-praman tarball to verify shipped .d.ts compatibility. Not part of the test suite. `playwright-praman` is deliberately absent from dependencies: the tarball path is only known at run time, so CI installs it with `npm install "$RUNNER_TEMP"/playwright-praman-*.tgz` (see the Consumer Types jobs in .github/workflows/ci.yml). Run the same command locally after `npm pack`.
